name: QFA 029 转弯卡阻 PFD仪副驾

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Qantas 029, your destination is Dubai, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 302. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 Qantas 029，目的地是迪拜，将从北京机场 302 号登机口离场。现在呼叫北京放行，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, QFA029, Gate 302, request ATC clearance to Dubai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，QFA029，302 号登机口，申请前往迪拜的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initial climb 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，北京放行，许可飞往迪拜，按飞行计划航路，初始爬升至 6600 米，RENOB 32 离场，航路中请求高度改变至 11000 米，应答机 1725，跑道 36 右，离场频率 127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往迪拜，按飞行计划航路，初始爬升至 6600 米，RENOB 32 离场，航路中请求高度改变至 11000 米，应答机 1725，跑道 36R，离场频率 127.75，QFA029。

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, read back correct, contact ground 121.9, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，复诵正确，联系地面 121.9，再见。

cards.audioText: B: You are ready to start up engines, call Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你准备好开车，呼叫地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, ready to start up.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, standby for start.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，等待开车。
cards.referenceText: Standby for start, QFA029.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, startup approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Startup approved, QFA029.

cards.audioText: B: You are ready for pushback now, call Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出，呼叫地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, request pushback.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, pushback approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，推出批准。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, QFA029.

cards.audioText: B: You have a problem: during pushback, the tow-bar is bent and you have to wait for another 1. Tell the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你有一个问题：推出期间，拖把弯曲，你必须等待另一个。告诉管制员。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, the tow bar is bent and we have to wait for another 1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，QFA029，拖把弯曲，我们必须等待另一个。

cards.audioText:
C: Qantas 029, roger, call me back when ready to taxi.
B: You are ready for taxiing, call Ground.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 029，收到，准备好滑行时再叫我。
B：你准备好滑行，呼叫地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, ready for taxi.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, taxi via taxiway Alpha 4 and Bravo 1 to holding point 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，经 Alpha 4 和 Bravo 1 滑行道滑行至 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A4 and B1 to holding point 36R, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A4 和 B1 滑行道滑行至 36R 等待点，QFA029。

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, taxi slower, give way to the Airbus coming from your right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，滑行慢一点，让从你右侧来的 Airbus 先行。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, QFA029.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, taxi with caution, work in progress on right side of the taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，谨慎滑行，滑行道右侧有施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA029.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, follow the Boeing 737.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，跟随 Boeing 737。
cards.referenceText: Follow the B737, QFA029.

cards.audioText: B: You now find your nose wheel steering seems to be jammed, tell the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现前轮转弯似乎卡住，告诉管制员。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, our nose wheel steering seems to be jammed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，QFA029，我们的前轮转弯似乎卡住。

cards.audioText:
C: Qantas 029, do you require a tug?
B: Say yes, you need towing assistance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 029，你是否需要牵引车？
B：回答是，你需要牵引协助。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request towing assistance, QFA029.

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, roger, hold and standby for a few minutes while I'll get a tug for you.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，收到，保持并等待几分钟，我会给你找一辆牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, QFA029.

cards.audioText: B: You are now airborne, time 32, you are passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters, contact Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，时间 32，正通过 1200 米并爬升至 1800 米，联系北京离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, airborne 32, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，QFA029，离地 32，正通过 1200 米，爬升至 1800 米。

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, cancel SID, turn left direct to Charlie Delta, climb to and maintain 6600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，取消 SID，左转直飞 Charlie Delta，爬升并保持 6600 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn left direct to CD, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，左转直飞 CD，爬升并保持 6600 米，QFA029。

cards.audioText: B: Your primary display system has a fault, request return to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的主显示系统故障，请求返回北京。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, request return to Beijing due primary display system malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，QFA029，因主显示系统故障，请求返回北京。

cards.audioText:
C: Qantas 029, say again please, I read you 2.
B: Tell the controller that the primary display system of yours broke down, only the co-pilot's display is working. For safety's sake, you want to return to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Qantas 029，请再说一遍，我听你信号 2。
B：告诉管制员你的主显示系统坏了，只有副驾驶显示器工作。为了安全，你想返回北京。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, my primary display system failed, only the co-pilot's display is working, request return to Beijing for safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，QFA029，我的主显示系统失效，只有副驾驶显示器工作，出于安全请求返回北京。

cards.audioText: C: Qantas 029, roger, turn left heading 180, radar vector to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Qantas 029，收到，左转航向 180，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 180, radar vector to land, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 180，雷达引导着陆，QFA029。
